questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
questions.answer: Explore new cultures

questions.question: Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: Jeg valgte udelukkende på baggrund af studieby ikke universitet, og jeg ville bare gerne til Rom.

questions.question: How would you rate your overall study abroad experience? *
Additional comments:
How easy was it to find the information you needed to know upon arrival? *
questions.answer: Det var virkelig nemt. LUISS var meget hjælpsomme og forudseende ift. at give den nødvendige information i tide.

questions.question: What assistance, if any, did you receive when you arrived at your study destination? *
questions.answer: Der var et webinar inden man skulle vælge fag, hvor de forklarede onlinesystemerne og alt relevant omkring at strikke et skema sammen. Ved ankomst var der en fælles intro forelæsning, hvor de introducerede alle Erasmus til universitet og gav mere info. Derudover udleverede de en "handbook" der indeholdt en ret fyldestgørende samling af al relevant information.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the orientation and assistance available to students at your host institution upon arrival? *
Additional comments
How did you find housing? *
questions.answer: I found housing on my own

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
questions.answer: Off campus

questions.question: How easy was it to find off campus housing? Any recommendations? *
questions.answer: Det var ret svært ift. udbuddet af lejligheder. Jeg var dog heldig på Spotahome. Generelt ville jeg anbefale at vælge at bo i gådistance fra uni, da offentlig transport er meget upålidelig og generelt træls.

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living off campus? *
questions.answer: Alle bor off-campus, det er som sådan udmærket.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the housing available to students? *
Additional comments:
How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: LUISS var gode til at få en indskrevet og give information ift. at vælge fag. Mindes ikke jeg stødte ind i problemer.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: LUISS har nogle ansatte, hvis eneste formål er at hjælpe udvekslingsfolk. De er vildt søde og har en virkelig kort responstid.

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: Jeg fik alle de kurser, som jeg ønskede. Man kan også skifte kurser indenfor første uge, hvilket der var nogen der gjorde. Så det var ikke svært at få de kurser man ønskede. Det var dog svært at strikke et skema sammen, hvor fagene ikke overlappede. Så på grund af overlap fik man ikke alle de fag man ellers gerne ville have haft.

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Bare tag det roligt. Det skal nok lykkes.

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: MA

questions.question: Did you take BA or MA classes while you were on exchange *
questions.answer: Both

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: Generelt er undervisningsniveauet meget lavere end i Danmark.

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: Meget tavleundervisning og generelt lidt studenterinddragelse. De eneste to kurser som var lidt "danske" i undervisningsmetoden var "EU Law Before Courts" og "International and European Taxation". Når det kom til eksamen var "International Organizations" også dansk i sværhedsgrad - selvom undervisningen ikke var.

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
questions.answer: 1 semester

questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your first semester. *
questions.answer:
1. EU Law Before Courts
2. Interntional and European Taxation
3. New Technologies and Labour Law
4. Media Law
5. International Organizations

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: EU Law Before Courts var faktisk indholdsmæssig vildt spændende med en sød professor, og man lærte faktisk en del. Omvendt kan jeg ikke anbefale Media Law, som jeg følte var spild af tid. Medmindre man leder efter et meget nemt fag, skal man holde sig fra det.

questions.question: Insurance DKK *
Housing DKK per month *
Books DKK per month *
Local transportation DKK per month *
Food DKK per month *
Personal spending DKK per month *
Communication (phone, internet, etc.) DKK per month *
Other fees DKK per month *
What unexpected costs did you encounter? *
questions.answer: Vand, varme, el er overraskende dyrt.

questions.question: What items were more or less expensive than you expected? *
questions.answer: Det er meget billigere at spise ude. Huslejen er overraskende høj og supermarkedspriser forholdsvis høje ift. at spise ude. Regionaltog til Roms omegn er mega billige! (typisk ca. 2EUR pr. tur).

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the non-academic opportunities (clubs, sports, etc.) at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
What kinds of cultural, athletic and social activities were available for students at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Der er en udvekslingsstudenterorganisation der arrangerer alle slags arrangementer. Både kultur, sport, udflugter etc. flere gange ugentlig. Så der er rig mulighed for at vælge til og fra.

questions.question: Which non -academic activities would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: I starten afholdes "Roman Dinner", som er det sjoveste arrangement at være med til siger rigtig mange. Man får mødt virkelig mange forskellige folk og kan bruge det som et fedt afsæt til resten af opholdet.

questions.question: What do you recommend other visiting students see or do on their weekends or holidays? *
questions.answer: Jeg havde selv været meget i Italien inden. Men vi tog en weekend til Bologna, som var virkelig hyggelig! Derudover er der en flot lille by for foden af bjergene bare en time fra Rom, Tivoli, hvor man kan gå en en-dags vandretur fra. Anbefaling!

questions.question: How easy was it to adjust to the local culture of your exchange site? *
questions.answer: Det var ret nemt. Romere er tilgængelige og byen er europæisk. Der er selvfølgelig lidt kaos i trafikken og det hele er lidt mere loose. Men det er en skøn by.

questions.question: Do you have any tips for socializing with local students?
questions.answer: De italienske studerende i min erfaring taler både vildt dårligt engelsk og er ikke særlig interesserede i at mødes. Så man skal nok ikke forvente et stort netværk af locals. Jeg var heldig at bo med flere der læste fast på LUISS, men ikke var italienere, så det var en rigtig god vej ind.

questions.question: What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
questions.answer: Måske temperamentet og deres manglende ordentlighed.

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: Maden og stemningen.

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer:
Tag på udveksling for en oplevelse, ikke akademisk fordybelse. 
Kom ud i byen og forsøg at opleve en masse. 
Lad være med at få for meget besøg, det kan godt gå hen og blive træls og man vil jo også leve der lidt uforstyrret.

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer: No.

questions.question: What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
questions.answer: Alle de søde mennesker man lærte at kende og venskaber man fik sig.

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer: At man ikke var med kæresten i så lang tid.

questions.question: Any other comments?
Do you agree to share your travel report with other fellow students? *
questions.answer: Yes
